messages.subject: RE: CL models openCR and variable effort
parts: Just a suspicion. My most recent primary session only used 3 secondary sessions instead of the usual 4 and the population estimate seems to be proportionally lower. I’m currently using JSSAsecrlCL instead of the usual JSSAsecrD to try and deal with some nonidentifiability.

Thanks,

messages.subject: Re: CL models openCR and variable effort
parts:
Varying number of secondary sessions per primary session is something else again, but should be handled automatically.
As ever, I am uncomfortable with reliance on openCR for density estimation.

On Monday, November 29, 2021 at 4:55:57 PM UTC+13 Cheryl Lohr wrote:

Just a suspicion. My most recent primary session only used 3 secondary sessions instead of the usual 4 and the population estimate seems to be proportionally lower. I’m currently using JSSAsecrlCL instead of the usual JSSAsecrD to try and deal with some nonidentifiability.

Thanks,

Cheryl
